title: Benchmark Copper Market Update
gist: Member-only Benchmark Week 2026 video page for Benchmark copper analyst Albert Mackenzie's copper market update (Nov 11, 2026). No transcript or figures: the only substantive content is a one-line agenda framing copper's role in electrification around supply constraints and demand from EVs, grid infrastructure and datacentres.

themes.theme: Copper in electrification: supply vs. demand

insights.claim: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence's copper market update at Benchmark Week 2026 frames copper's role in electrification around supply constraints on one side and demand from EVs, grid infrastructure and datacentres on the other.
insights.speaker: Albert Mackenzie, Copper Analyst, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Benchmark treats copper as a supply-constrained electrification metal with datacentres added to EVs and grids as demand drivers.
insights.quote: Copper’s role in electrification: supply constraints and demand from EVs, grid infrastructure and datacentres.

insights.claim: Datacentres are named alongside EVs and grid infrastructure as a copper demand source in Benchmark's copper market update, which places AI and compute buildout inside the copper demand story.
insights.speaker: Albert Mackenzie, Copper Analyst, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Datacentre buildout is a copper demand lever investors can track alongside EV and grid capex.

insights.claim: The copper market update video by Albert Mackenzie is member-only content, so no prices, balances or forecasts are publicly available from the page.
insights.speaker: Albert Mackenzie, Copper Analyst, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: The actual copper numbers sit behind Benchmark's paywall; this card holds only the framing.

source_meta.author: Albert Mackenzie, Copper Analyst, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
